title: Tea, Please: Small Ya, Small Yo and Wo
label: ch:ja-tea-please-small-ya-small-yo-wo
canDo: I can write small ya, small yo and wo, read words that use them, and ask for tea politely.

payoff.summary: Read ocha, isha, chotto and toshokan with their beats, write ocha o kudasai from memory with を for the particle, and write the three new signs once each.
payoff.note: Word before sign, every time. Each of the three signs is first SEEN inside a word taught one lesson earlier -- ocha for small ya, chotto for small yo, ocha o kudasai for wo -- and only then written, so every letter lesson is anchored (HL-C443) rather than building toward a later word. Two lessons separate each writing lesson from the next, and each new sign is spent at once in a second word (isha, toshokan) or in the review.
